newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bhutto stopped, then allowed to leave Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Bhutto stopped, then allowed to leave Pakistan.

text.p: Pakistani police stopped opposition leader Benazir Bhutto from boarding a London-bound plane at Karachi on Tuesday but later allowed her to leave by another flight on orders from the Interior Ministry, her party said.
Government officials were not immediately available to comment about the matter.

The Pakistan People's Party said in a statement that Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) police at Karachi airport stopped Bhutto from boarding an Emirates Airlines flight to London, saying the government had put her name on a list of people banned from leaving the country.
It said the Interior Ministry later told the agency to allow Bhutto to leave after her political secretary called the ministry in Islamabad to protest.
Bhutto later left for London on a Pakistan International Airlines flight, the statement said.
